verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS platform with admin and directory APIs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, test domain, or non-production environment. The cited items cover admin APIs, reports, SSO, device management and Apps Script automation, none of which provide isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
